newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Tyrolean Airways hikes ticket prices.
newsitem.headline: Tyrolean Airways hikes ticket prices.

text.p: Tyrolean Airways Tiroler Luftfahrt- AG said on Monday it was raising prices today by an average of three percent because of higher jet fuel costs.
Prices on scheduled domestic flights would rise by two percent, international tickets by three percent and charter prices by four percent, Tyrolean said in a statement.
Last week Austrian Airlines, which owns 42.85 percent of Tyrolean, said it would raise prices for scheduled flights by three percent this week.

Lauda Air last month hiked its ticket prices by four percent. British Airways and Royal Dutch Airlines also have announced higher prices to offset a 50 percent rise in kerosene prices over the past few months.
